chunks: Has your Lord chosen to give you sons, and taken for Himself daughters from among the angels? You utter grievous things indeed!
ai.seo_question: Why did the polytheists attribute daughters to Allah according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Tawhid* (Divine Oneness) by critiquing the anthropomorphic projection of human gender preferences onto the Divine. The polytheists' attribution of daughters to Allah, while reserving sons for themselves, is seen as a manifestation of their tribal pride and logical inconsistency, further emphasized by the contrast with the genderless nature of angels.
